admit site vm of f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01 as paisans-f2a9 on fake (ubuntu 22.04)

step 1: claim the host
step 2: create /etc/paisans
step 3: record what admit installs

step 4: install packages: docker-ce-rootless-extras=5:29.9.1-1~ubuntu.22.04~jammy, uidmap
  packages: install docker-ce-rootless-extras=5:29.9.1-1~ubuntu.22.04~jammy uidmap, leaving your Docker at the version it is
  run:
    $ set -e
    $ if [ -z "${paisans_hold_locked:-}" ]; then
    $   exec 8>/run/paisans-docker-hold.lock
    $   flock -n 8 || { echo 'another paisans host admit is installing Docker on this host now (it holds /run/paisans-docker-hold.lock). Run again once it is done'; exit 1; }
    $   paisans_hold_locked=1
    $ fi
    $ confirm_claims() {
    $   f=/etc/paisans/installed
    $   { [ -f "$f" ] && [ ! -L "$f" ]; } || return 0
    $   ok=
    $   for p in $(awk 'NF == 2 && $1 == "installing" && $2 ~ /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.+-]+$/ { print $2 }' "$f"); do
    $     s=$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}' "$p" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    $     case $s in *" not-installed"|*" config-files"|"") ;; *) ok="$ok $p" ;; esac
    $   done
    $   [ -n "$ok" ] || return 0
    $   t=$(mktemp "$f.XXXXXX") || return 1
    $   if awk -v ok="$ok " 'NF == 2 && $1 == "installing" && index(ok, " " $2 " ") { print "package " $2; next } { print }' "$f" > "$t" && chmod 644 "$t"; then
    $     mv -f "$t" "$f"
    $   else
    $     rm -f "$t"
    $     return 1
    $   fi
    $ }
    $ trap confirm_claims EXIT
    $ trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM
    $ set -e
    $ export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
    $ apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 update 8>&-
    $ apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold install -y --no-upgrade docker-ce-rootless-extras=5:29.9.1-1~ubuntu.22.04~jammy uidmap 8>&-

step 5: create user paisans-f2a9
step 6: skip the mesh until its conf exists
step 7: start paisans-f2a9's manager after the mesh
step 8: delegate cgroups to users
step 9: write the egress table
step 10: install the egress unit
step 11: load the egress table
step 12: enable linger for paisans-f2a9
step 13: start paisans-f2a9's manager
step 14: load br_netfilter
step 15: load br_netfilter at boot
step 16: write paisans-f2a9's daemon.json

step 17: install paisans-f2a9's rootless Docker
  daemon: dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install --force, as paisans-f2a9, which starts the daemon reading its daemon.json; --force because a system daemon may run beside it
  provisional: run once the user exists
  run:
    $ runuser -u paisans-f2a9 -- env -i HOME='/home/paisans-f2a9' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/<uid> DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/<uid>/bus DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/<uid>/docker.sock sh -c 'dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install --force'
